$comment: VAPP-191 (eApps Q2, spec docs/spec/apps.md §4.2-4.4): the expression language, ONE fixture for the TS reference (src/cel.ts) and the Rust core (eui_core::cel), replayed by the FFI facade and the Swift and Compose SDKs. The string form is a SUBSET of CEL: number/string/bool/null/list literals, names, field paths a.b, indexes a[0] / m['k'], + - * / %, unary - and !, == != < <= > >=, && || (short-circuit), c ? a : b, the function table, and the macros map/filter/all/exists, single level. ONE number type (a double, like JSON: 7 / 2 = 3.5; CEL splits int/uint/double); no implicit conversion; a missing field (or a field of null) reads null; == is deep JSON equality; strings compare by UTF-16 code unit. Errors are exact texts; a parse error starts `at <code point>: `. Functions (also the A2UI form {call, args}): mul{a,b} div{a,b} mod{a,b} round{value,digits?} (half away from zero, digits 0..10) floor ceil abs{value} min max{values} today{} now{} dateAdd{date,n,unit} dateDiff{a,b,unit} (b - a, truncated) startOf endOf{date,unit} weekday{date} (ISO, Monday 1) isoWeek{date} hours{minutes} formatDuration{hours,format} (h:mm, hh:mm), size (CEL only), and expr{expr, vars} = the string form at bind time; a failed call has NO value (`none`). A date is `YYYY-MM-DD` (a calendar day), a timestamp an ISO instant (no offset = UTC; written back as toISOString). Everything date-like runs in the TEAM zone `zones[env.zone]` = a UTC offset per instant (minutes east, `offset` until the first transition, then each `[at, offset]`): a day unit keeps the wall clock (a time in a DST gap moves forward by the gap, a repeated time takes its later instant), second/minute/hour are real time. Units: second minute hour day week month quarter year (startOf/endOf: day..year; a date takes no sub-day unit in dateAdd). Cost: `limits` (maxLength code points, maxDepth = nested expressions and unary operators, maxSteps = evaluated nodes + comprehension iterations; a case's `maxSteps` overrides). `eval`: expr over `vars` in `env` (a case may override now / zone) → value | error. `check`: the type checker at package validation over `checkTypes` (types spelled as JSON: number string bool null date timestamp map dyn, [T] = a list, an object = a row with exactly those fields) → type | error. `calls`: the A2UI form resolved over `callData` (bind time) → value | none, and its `cel` twin over the same data as vars agrees. `packages`: validatePackage's expression issues: every {call: expr} anywhere in a template is parsed and checked; a var's type comes from a literal, a records binding (`records:<kind>` / `exp:records?kind=`: {rows: [row], count, sum, groups, totals, before, month}; a row = the kind's schema fields + id createdAt updatedAt createdBy authorId author) or the template data; anything else is dyn.
